## Dev and prod environments

When we push the code, we automatically deploy the changes, and they go live immediately.
It’s okay when we are just starting to work on our project.
But when we have real users, we want to be more careful and check that our changes didn’t introduce any regressions.

To avoid having this problem, we usually have two copies of the same environment:

* Dev (development): the environment we use internally for checking that everything works.
